historical_evidence_policy.reason: The old White failure and rail record were captured with a broken display FPC. They remain immutable history, not a diagnosis or acceptance result for the replacement FPC.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not change expression, menu, recording, CEMP, or normal refresh policy during the official White/Black retest.
Do not use TP_INT/PC6 or optional TP_RST/PC10 as e-paper recovery wiring.
Do not promote historical visible-refresh evidence as current acceptance.
Do not load the unaffiliated 0xC7/one-second LUT or invent a waveform from the replacement-FPC observation.
recovery_order: Validate the versioned owner-reported replacement display-FPC evidence; the existing logic input remains 3.3 V only.
Under the Companion-WB55 workflow lock, run the existing source-bound official White diagnostic and record one focused visible result.
Capture a new labelled PREVGH1/PREVGL1 artifact during that verified White refresh; only a PASS machine-and-rails artifact can unlock Black.
Run Black only after the new White rail artifact passes, then record one focused visible result.
After solid white and black pass, run RestoreNormal, then prove the current expression, one partial transition, touch, and one maintenance boundary.

operator_sequence: Run White only after the versioned replacement-display-FPC evidence passes; the runner holds the Companion-WB55 firmware mutex across flash, capture, review and restore.
Only after White rail evidence passes, run Black and record one focused visible-frame decision.
Run RestoreNormal before any product interaction or runtime-resource acceptance.
If either visible frame fails, measure PREVGH1/PREVGL1 during that verified refresh and stop software changes.

remaining_non_go_facts: Exact GDEY0154D67-T03 temperature applicability and panel/FPC/controller identity evidence for the supplier one-second LUT.
A separately authorized sparse expression sequence with six distinct frames and focused residue review; no such fast-LUT experiment has run.
target: NUCLEO-WB55RG + ESP32-FTS02 + replacement display FPC + GDEY0154D67-T03
wba_impact: Keep this failure target-local. WBA55/WBA65 reuse portable screen, expression, touch, and refresh-intent contracts but require their own panel power/rail implementation and real hardware evidence.
